title: Ink Velocity
one_line: Draw the road and send a red supercar across the Darjeeling hills, under real Kanchenjunga peaks.
how_to_play: Draw a road with your mouse or finger from the cliff to the finish flag, then press GO (Space). Ink is limited. The Turbo pen draws blue boost strips. You can keep drawing while the car drives. Hold NITRO (Shift) to boost and BRAKE (S) to slow down; lean in the air with the arrow buttons (A / D) and land flips for stunts. R puts the car back and keeps your roads.
description: A draw-the-road driving puzzle set in the Darjeeling hills. Sketch bridges, ramps and turbo strips across canyons, then watch your supercar take them on: climbs, drops, crates to push, a spinning windmill, stepping-stone pillars and a long night jump. Behind you rise the real snow peaks of Kanchenjunga, tea garden terraces, prayer flags, a hillside town and the blue toy train puffing past. 8 levels in morning, golden hour and moonlight. Earn 3 stars per level for finishing, saving ink and collecting every coin, and paint your car in the garage.
